content:
I've just finished a proof of Sion's Minimax Theorem, which is (I think) of suitable generality for Mathlib: it's a version of the minima theorem that holds over any (possible infinite-dimensional) real vector space, for a function which is appropriately upper-/lower-semicontinuous, and quasi-convex/-concave; where both arguments are taken over a convex set, but actually only one is required to be compact.

(Discussion: #general > Sion's Minimax @ 💬 )
